You can visit our My5 Help centre for information about these improvements and how to reset your password and sign-in: help.channel5.com

accessibilitySettings.description:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com

policies.text:
Channel 5 uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

policies.text:

policies.text:

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

policies.title: My5 And Your Data
policies.text:
Channel 5 uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

To allow the use of your data to personalise your advertising and application experience click on ‘Accept all’. For full control of how we use your data click on edit settings and tell us what you’re happy with.
policies.dataText: We’d like to use the information you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and deliver more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising. We will share your data to help make this experience a reality. – please let us know if you consent to the use of your data for this purpose.
policies.cookiesText: We’d like to store cookies on your device to be able to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising – please let us know if you consent to the use of cookies for this purpose.

policies.accessibilityText:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The new My5 website is still in its Beta phase which means it is still in development. We are actively working to increase the accessibility and usability of our website to enable all users to watch our content. Accessibility updates will be gradually made over the coming weeks in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) and with input from specialist organisations and users.

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com

policies.accessibilityText:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com

policies.accessibilityText:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com

announcements.announcementsText: We’ve made some improvements to the My5 website and as a result you will need to sign-in again in order to access your personalised recommendations, watch history, search history, add shows to My List, and manage your My5 account. policies.accessibilityText:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

policies.title: My5 And Your Data
policies.text:
Channel 5 uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

policies.title: My5 And Your Data
policies.text:
Channel 5 uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

To allow the use of your data to personalise your advertising and application experience click on ‘Accept all’. For full control of how we use your data click on edit settings and tell us what you’re happy with.
policies.dataText: We’d like to use the information you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and deliver more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising. We will share your data to help make this experience a reality. – please let us know if you consent to the use of your data for this purpose.

policies.title: Your Data
policies.text:
The 5 app uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your 5 app experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

To allow the use of your data to personalise your advertising and application experience click on ‘Accept all’. For full control of how we use your data click on edit settings and tell us what you’re happy with.

policies.accessibilityText:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com

policies.text:
Channel 5 uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

To further enhance your experience, please click on Accept to agree to the use of cookies for 'targeted’ advertising or Edit Choices to manage your cookie preferences.

policies.accessibilityText:
Channel 5 is committed to making its products accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

The My5 website has been reviewed and attained AA conformity status for use with keyboard and screen readers, in line with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

If you have any feedback or suggestions about accessibility, please contact our viewer enquiries team on 020 3580 3600 or 03457 050505 or e-mail them on viewerenquiries@channel5.com
policies.registerConfirmation: I confirm I have read and accept the Terms & Conditions.

announcements.announcementsText: We’ve made some improvements to the My5 website and as a result you will need to sign-in again in order to access your personalised recommendations, watch history, search history, add shows to My List, and manage your My5 account. policies.text:

policies.title: My5 And Your Data
policies.text:
Channel 5 uses cookies and the data which you provide to us to personalise your My5 experience and enable us to serve you with more relevant ‘targeted’ advertising.

For detailed information about how we use the data we store, you can read our privacy and cookie policies by clicking on the privacy policy link below.

To allow the use of your data to personalise your advertising and application experience click on ‘Accept all’. For full control of how we use your data click on edit settings and tell us what you’re happy with.
